item.description: Microsoft on Friday apologised for a global outage that disrupted public services and businesses around the world, as it reported a “broad recovery” for Outlook email and other services. The company ruled out any malicious “cyber or AI” activity as the cause of the outage, which affected several Microsoft products and disrupted healthcare services, delayed corporate earnings reports and left schools struggling to communicate. “We are deeply sorry for the disruption this incident has caused our... item.title: ¿Cuáles son las consecuencias económicas y políticas del escándalo de Nvidia?
item.description: La renuncia de Jensen Huang como director ejecutivo de la tecnológica Nvidia ha sacudido la bolsa de Wall Street y provocado varias reacciones en Estados Unidos, luego de que se conociera su relación extramatrimonial con una mujer china que presuntamente realizó actividades de espionaje para Beijing. En nuestra sección #InvitadoDelDíaF24 hablamos con Sergio Cesarín, licenciado en Relaciones Internacionales y con maestría por la Universidad de Beijing, sobre las consecuencias económicas, políticas y estratégicas para Nvidia y sobre los retos inmediatos de la directora ejecutiva interina… Fuente: France 24 - Español.

item.title: Former Fox host Maria Bartiromo sells $6.5M Manhattan townhouse for $7M
item.description: In a notable real estate transaction, Maria Bartiromo and her spouse, Jonathan Steinberg, finalized the sale of their Manhattan townhouse for a hefty $7 million. This sale occurred confidentially shortly after Bartiromo's departure from Fox News Media, following over 12 years with the network. Having purchased the five-storey residence nearly 19 years ago for $6.5 million, they faced a monetary loss when adjusted for inflation. Fuente: The Times of India - World.
